Also mounts whole skill families in and out of the host's skill hub.","id":"gh:1410562745","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-skill-switch","slug":"EdisonYang1982/dsh-skill-switch","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-session skill switch for DeepSeek Harness: see which skills a session loads, toggle them off, an"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"d keep a pure-chat session free of skill overhead. Also mounts whole skill families in and out of th"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"session free of skill overhead. Also mounts whole skill families in and out of the host's skill hub."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-skill-switch"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A DeepSeek Harness plugin about **spending fewer tokens on skills you are not
> using** — by sessi"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"on, and by whole family."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Every session gets a collapsible strip above the composer showing which skills
it loads, with a togg"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"le per skill and three posture presets. Large interdependent
skill families can be parked outside th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e host's skill hub entirely and mounted as
one unit."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## The problem: skills cost tokens even when unused"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH skills are already lazily loaded — the model only reads a `SKILL.md` body when
it calls the `ski"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ll` tool. **The catalog is not lazy.** Before every step, the
official `tool-skill` injects every mo"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"del-invocable skill as an
`<available_skills>` block, so a skill you never touch still bills you on "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"every
single step. And there is no way to say "this session is just a conversation — do
not offer me"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" any of these" before it starts."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Three layers, and which one actually matters"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The design targets three separate costs, in ascending order of size:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Layer | Mechanism | What it saves |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Skill removed from the catalog | One descr"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"iption line |
| 2 | Model cannot see it, so it never loads it | **The whole `SKILL.md` body** |
[该节后"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"on line |
| 2 | Model cannot see it, so it never loads it | **The whole `SKILL.md` body** |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Why per-session, and why per-family"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Two design choices follow from how skills are actually used:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Per session**, because intent changes by conversation. A pure brainstorming
session should not p"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ay for the coding toolkit, and a "no skills at all" posture
should be one click rather than an argum"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ent with the model.
- **Per family**, because some families cannot be split. Their members link each"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"
other by relative path (`lark-doc` → `../lark-shared`), so loading one alone
breaks its references,"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" while listing all of them bills every line. All-or-nothing
is not a simplification — it is the only"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" shape that matches the dependency."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Why it takes over `tool-skill`"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Two constraints rule out a lighter interception:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. **`ctx.skills.registerProvider()` always files into the GLOBAL layer**, and its
`list()` receives"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" only `{ cwd, signal }` — no agent identity — so a provider
cannot branch per session.
2. **The offi"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"cial catalog compares digests.** Filtering behind its back makes it
see a changed catalog and publis"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"h a replacement message on *every step*,
polluting the session log."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"So this plugin owns the catalog injection and the `skill` tool, registering them on
`agent.ctx`. `to"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ols.register` reads the **caller's** scope, so the registration is
per-session and is collected when"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" the agent is disposed."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Why disabling everything unmounts the tool instead of using `tools.restrict()`**:
a restriction fi"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lters only what a scope *inherits* and never what its own layer
registers. The `skill` tool is regis"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"tered in the agent's own layer, so a
restriction cannot remove it and its schema would stay in the p"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"rompt — layer 3 of
the token model above would be unreachable. Unmounting the registration is what
a"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ctually takes the schema out of the prompt."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Why the takeover is worth its maintenance cost.** The alternative — leaving the
official plugin in"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" place and filtering behind it — cannot work, for the digest
reason above: every step would append a"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" catalog-update message, so the "saving"
would cost more context than it recovered. Owning the injec"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"tion is the price of
the per-session switch existing at all."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Cost**: upstream changes to `dsh-tool-skill` are not picked up automatically. The
logic here is a "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"port of the official implementation and behaves identically."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Version compatibility"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"DSH validates a third-party bundle's peer ranges and **silently skips the whole
bundle** when they d"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"o not match — the plugin does not load, but its patch still
applies. Two things bite:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. **The runtime version is not the version in the profile.** The desktop app
redirects `@deepseek-a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"i/*` to the packages inside its own asar
(`0.2.0-rc.2` today) via the loader's
`internal.import(spec"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ifier, bareModuleBaseUrl)`, not to
`<profile>/node_modules`. Writing a peer range from the profile's"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" copies can
therefore fail validation.
2. **The version on npm is not the version the runtime provid"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"es either.** The
check compares each range against the *runtime* version, so a package that
stopped "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"publishing to npm at `0.1.x` while the runtime ships `0.2.x` still has
to be ranged against `0.2.x`."},{"id":"p24s7","text":" Ranging it against what npm happens to offer
rejects the bundle. This is the mistake that shipped i"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"n `5b85d5d`:
`dsh-client-runtime` publishes only up to `0.1.1-rc.2` on npm, but the desktop
runtime "},{"id":"p24s9","text":"provides `0.2.0-rc.2`, so a `^0.1.x` range skipped the whole plugin.
3. **A peer range without an ex"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"plicit prerelease branch silently excludes every
prerelease build.** Use a union that names the prer"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"ease branch silently excludes every
prerelease build.** Use a union that names the prerelease tuple:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**Diagnosing**: `plugin_manager list_bundles` — look for
`error.code: "incompatible-version"` on the"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" bundle. The failure is silent from
the plugin's side: it does not load, yet its `cordis.patch.yml` "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"still applies, so
`tool-skill` stays disabled while nothing takes over the `skill` tool."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**Verifying a range before shipping**: check it against the runtime version with
the same library DS"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"H uses, rather than by reading version lists."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Takes over the official `skill` tool.** Upstream changes to `dsh-tool-skill`
need manual follow-"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"up.
- **Skill discovery is not this plugin's job.** The web composition disables the
host `skill-fil"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"esystem` row ("presets own local discovery"); a deployment that
wants a local repository re-enables "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"that provider against its own hub. This
plugin only filters what the registry already knows about.
-"},{"id":"p30s5","text":" **Group membership by discovery reads `parkDir` only.** A family mounted and then
deleted from the "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"hub by hand loses its roster on the next restart.
- Session state is in-memory; only group state is "},{"id":"p30s7","text":"and loses its roster on the next restart.
